office: the Direction Générale de la Documentation Nationale (DGDN), at the public security commissariats

routes.label: at a public security commissariat in Lomé or a prefecture

note: The DGDN's page for the CNI: compulsory for every Togolese citizen of 18 or older; applied for at the commissariats of public security in Lomé and the prefectures; a receipt of 5,000 FCFA among the documents. The card's term and the time aren't on the page.

sources.title: Direction Générale de la Documentation Nationale (Togo), Carte nationale d'identité
sources.said: La CNI est un document obligatoire pour tout citoyen togolais âgé de 18 ans ou plus ... Une quittance de 5.000 FCFA
